Non reentrant for the same Fr Nm Cluster Parameters (in) nm Network Handle Identification of the NM - Cluster Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value None Description This API service of an upper layer BSW module <UL> (e.g. Com M) is called by the Flex Ray Network Management to indicate to this upper layer BSW module that the "Remote Sleep" has been cancelled as an NM - message with an indication to keep the bus awake has been received and the Remote Sleep indication has been previously detected .
